effects.printed_clause: Activate 1 Bauy World directly from your Deck or banishment, or, if you control Bauy World, Special Summon 1 Bau Tuner from your Deck or banishment instead.
effects.lua_implementation: The selected Bauy World is moved face-up to the Field Zone, its activation count and cost are consumed, and custom activation event 4179255 is raised exactly as in Omega's direct-Field-Spell activation scripts.

official_references.matched_structure: Directly activates a named Field Spell and executes its activation effect.
Moves and activates a Field Spell directly from the Deck.
Official alternative between activating a Field Spell and another destination.

effects.issue: Rejected: official Generaider Boss Fight, Demise of the Land, and Metaverse do not manually invoke the moved Field Spell's target or operation either. The current Lua follows Omega's exact direct-activation protocol.

effects.printed_clause: Then, if you control Bau, you can negate the effects of 1 face-up card on the field, and if you do, banish that card.
effects.lua_implementation: After either primary branch succeeds, the operation rechecks control of exact card BAU, optionally selects one face-up card on either field, applies EFFECT_DISABLE/EFFECT_DISABLE_EFFECT, then banishes it only if disabled.

official_references.matched_structure: Negates a face-up card with EFFECT_DISABLE and EFFECT_DISABLE_EFFECT.
Non-destruction effect negation followed by further resolution logic.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is banished: You can Set this card, but shuffle it into the Deck when it leaves the field.
effects.lua_implementation: An optional delayed EVENT_REMOVE trigger Sets the handler and registers EFFECT_LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT with LOCATION_DECKSHF and redirect reset.

official_references.matched_structure: Self-Set from a non-field location followed by a leave-field redirect.
Sets itself and registers a leave-field banish redirect; same structural reset pattern with a different destination.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Bauy Spellcasting once per turn.
